title: Latent Harness: Compiling Agent Behaviors into Post-Block Activation Shifts
abstract: arXiv:2611.01415v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Harness engineering and self-evolving agents improve language-model agents quickly, yet their gains live outside the model. The harness is re-sent and re-paid on every call, and the standard route to internalization is a weight update that is costly to iterate and fixed once merged. We propose compiling the harness instead. Latent Harness distills an external condition into a rank-8 activation shift. The shift is applied at the output of every decoder block of a frozen backbone, at 0.03-0.05% of parameters. The condition is either an explicit process-level behavior instruction or the behavioral contract of an agentic harness. At inference the compiled bundle carries no harness text and adds no tokens. It exposes three runtime controls for injection strength, injection phase, and shift-space mixing. Compiled behaviors recover the source-harness gain in 8 of 10 preregistered settings. translated_title: 潜在框架：将智能体行为编译为解码块后的激活偏移
translated_abstract: 框架工程与自我进化智能体能够快速提升语言模型智能体的能力，但这些收益存在于模型之外。框架在每次调用时都需要重新发送并重新支付成本，而将行为内化的标准途径是权重更新——这种方式迭代成本高昂，且一旦合并便固定不变。我们提出改为对框架进行“编译”。Latent Harness 将外部条件蒸馏为一个秩为 8 的激活偏移，该偏移被施加于冻结骨干网络的每个解码器块的输出处，仅涉及 0.03-0.05% 的参数。外部条件既可以是显式的过程级行为指令，也可以是智能体框架的行为契约。在推理时，编译后的产物不携带任何框架文本，也不增加任何 token，并暴露三个运行时控制项：注入强度、注入阶段和偏移空间混合。编译后的行为在 10 个预先注册的设置中的 8 个里恢复了源框架的收益。在显式来源每次调用代价最高的场景……
tldr: 本文提出 Latent Harness，将外部框架条件或行为指令蒸馏为施加在冻结模型每个解码器块输出上的秩8激活偏移（仅0.03-0.05%参数），使智能体行为无需框架文本和额外token即可内化进模型，并在10个预注册设置中的8个恢复源框架收益。
en_tdlr: Latent Harness compiles external harness conditions into rank-8 activation shifts applied at each decoder block output of a frozen backbone (0.03-0.05% of parameters), internalizing agent behaviors with no harness text or extra tokens at inference and recovering source-harness gains in 8 of 10 preregistered settings.
